name: Slick
author: Erin Carter
description: An iridescent oil-slick color field — broad palette poles fold and churn through one another like thin film on water, thin-film bands sweeping slow rainbows across the surface. Pure soft color, no hard structure, dusted with film grain.

params.label: Drift speed
params.effect: How fast the slick churns and the colour bands sweep; 0 holds it nearly still.

params.label: Folding
params.effect: Depth of the liquid domain-warp; low is broad smooth banks, high is tight oily folds.

params.label: Blob scale
params.effect: Feature scale of the colour poles; low spreads two or three huge blobs, high packs in more.

params.label: Iridescence
params.effect: Sharpness and frequency of the thin-film rainbow bands.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer pulls the colour field toward it; 0 ignores the mouse.
